target.title: fix(memory-core): skip unchanged Dreaming workspace state writes
target.body:
Closes #111376

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where memory-core Dreaming would rewrite every workspace entry in the `dreaming-session-ingestion-files` plugin-state namespace even when no values changed. On long-lived workspaces this full rewrite can stall the gateway event loop for tens of seconds and coincide with control-plane / channel instability during a Dreaming run.

## Why This Change Was Made

`writeMemoryCoreWorkspaceEntries` now reads existing workspace rows once, compares each desired canonical value with `isDeepStrictEqual`, and calls `register()` only for new or changed rows. Rows missing from the desired set are still deleted. This preserves the existing replacement semantics while removing avoidable write amplification on the common unchanged second pass.

Fix quality: compatibility — same public API and final serialized state; performance — skips unchanged `register()` work on no-op rewrites; usability — no new config; security — no trust-boundary change.

## User Impact

Operators running managed Dreaming on large workspaces should no longer pay a full plugin-state rewrite when workspace ingestion state is unchanged. Gateway event-loop pressure from redundant Dreaming state writes should drop substantially on stable workspaces.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass).

Focused contract tests:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-state-write.test.ts
 ✓ |extension-memory| extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-state-write.test.ts (4 tests)
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  4 passed (4)
```

Sibling regression:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-repair.test.ts
 ✓ |extension-memory| extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-repair.test.ts (8 tests)
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
```

Path-scoped static:

```text
oxfmt (2 files) — clean
oxlint (2 files, 212 rules) — 0 warnings / 0 errors
git diff --check — clean
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Dreaming workspace writer no longer rewrites unchanged plugin-state rows; only new/changed rows are registered and removed keys are deleted.
- Environment: local macOS, openclaw checkout at `origin/main` tip + this patch, focused Vitest via `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs`, instrumented plugin-state store counting `register`/`delete`.
- Current-main contrast: on main, `writeMemoryCoreWorkspaceEntries` unconditionally `await store.register(...)` for every desired entry before scanning deletes, so an identical second write registers every row again (e.g. 3/3 registers for three entries).
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/memory-core/src/dreaming-state-write.test.ts`
  2. Cases exercise first write, identical second write, single-value change, delete-only removal, and multi-workspace isolation.
- Evidence after fix: identical second run → `register=0`, `delete=0`; one changed value → `register=1`; one removed key → `delete=1` and final readback matches desired set.
- Control check: instrumented counts only observe the production writer path; multi-workspace test confirms another workspace’s rows are neither deleted nor rewritten; final `readMemoryCoreWorkspaceEntries` asserts serialized logical state.
- Observed result after fix: all four contract tests passed; sibling dreaming-repair suite still green.
- What was not tested: full live gateway Dreaming run against a multi-thousand-row production workspace; event-loop delay measurement under load.

## AI disclosure

This PR was authored with AI assistance (Grok).
